personality_one_liner: An immersive, crystal-clear anatomical explorer pairing tactile iOS navigation with interactive 3D organ visualization.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room and iOS vertical rhythm with safe area padding.

do's: Use frosted glass headers over scrolling organ grids
Use translucent bottom action sheets for 3D link launch
dont's: Do not blur form inputs or text readouts

screens.name: Auth / Welcome
screens.purpose: Email/password login, signup, and guest entry with clean iOS styling.

states.empty: Enter email and password to begin.
states.error: Invalid email or password. Please retry.

screens.layout: Vertical centered hero with medical symbol mark, tabbed segment for Login / Signup, input fields with validation, sticky primary CTA, and subtle 'Continue as Guest' secondary action.

screens.name: Organ Gallery
screens.purpose: Explore human body organs including lungs, liver, kidney, and heart with gorgeous visual cards.

states.error: Failed to connect to anatomical models service. Retry.

screens.layout: Header with user greeting and account badge, search bar, and a responsive vertical list of organ cards featuring real imagery, clinical stats, and 3D badges.

screens.name: Organ Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed anatomical breakdown of the selected organ with clinical facts and direct launch into the interactive 3D model viewer.

states.error: Could not load organ specs. Retry.

screens.layout: Hero image with gradient scrim, collapsible stats panel, physiological breakdown, and a sticky bottom action bar featuring 'Launch 3D Interactive Model'.

screens.name: 3D Model Viewer
screens.purpose: In-app browser viewer rendering the external 3D anatomy link (e.g. lungs 3D model) inside a secure native web view with toolbar.

states.error: Failed to load 3D web viewer. Check connection and retry.

screens.layout: Top navigation bar with back control, organ title, share action, full-screen WebView with loading indicator, and bottom floating interaction hint bar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure real email/password authentication is fully wired with backend session state. Provide guest entry bypass option. Build the 4 key screens: Auth, Organ Gallery, Organ Detail, and In-App 3D Viewer (WebView). Ensure lungs link https://glittering-bublanina-243c34.netlify.app/ is correctly passed when opening the lungs 3D viewer. Follow iOS-native Clean palette and touch targets.
